name: West Chester YMCA Camp
description_short: YMCA day camp at the West Chester Area YMCA for ages 5 to 15, grouped by age, with daily swimming, gaga, a hammock village, arts and crafts, sports and nature, and field trips every other week. Also offers aquatics camps for ages 7 to 11, Teen Trek for ages 12 to 15 and a Leaders in Training program.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least two weeks before the camp week for a refund of fees paid, less the non-refundable $35 a week deposit; no refunds or changes within two weeks of the start, or for illness.

sessions.name: Week 1: Jurassic Jungle (no camp Friday June 19)

notes: 2026 prices shown are the guest (non-member) weekly rates: traditional camp $465 (members $379); aquatics camps $442 ($388); Teen Trek $505 ($397); Leaders in Training $400 ($250). Week 1 is four days and prorated. Camp 9 to 4; Morning SPARK 7 to 9 is $25 a week; 4 to 6 pm is included. Sibling discount; YMCA financial assistance accepted.
